plan.notes: Official UNO catalog Four Year Plan for the BS in Biology (College of Arts and Sciences). The catalog publishes this plan with a total of 117-123 credits (variable-credit science/general-education slots shown as ranges). Three variable slots were set to in-range values (5, 5, 4 instead of minimums 4, 4, 3) so the plan sums to the 120-hour UNO degree minimum, disclosed here per convention. Blank cells are recorded as labeled choice slots for science requirements, general education, major electives, or free electives. Plan is a suggested roadmap, not a contract; students must meet with an advisor.
